_comment: The canonical module taxonomy for the Tiger directory + WebTigers Marketplace. WebTigers owns this file — a listing's `type` and `category` must be one of the ids below (enforced at compile/review). Developers PICK from this list; they cannot invent new types/categories. For the long tail, a listing's `keywords` are FREE-FORM (any string) and power search only, never the filters. This file is folded into data/index.json by scripts/compile-index.php so a single fetch gives Tiger both the catalog and its filter vocabulary.
